notes: Custom runtime storage lets fresh installs keep environments, models, caches, logs, and Gary-trained LoRAs beside the app or on another drive.
Existing installs keep using their current AppData and Hugging Face storage unless you choose a new location.
The storage panel can show disk use and clean up individual environments, models, the UV package cache, duplicated model copies, and old managed storage.
Gary now accepts seeded advanced controls and has a safer attention fallback. Compatible with gary4juce v4.0.13.
